notes.subject: נמשל/נדמו
notes.rationale: Root echo between ni-mashal (likened) and nidmu (perished/silenced) — both from near-identical roots, lost in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: pinis
notes.rationale: נדמו literally 'be dumb/silent', hence 'fail, perish' — 'pinis' captures the end but not the silence.

notes.subject: bikpela nem
notes.rationale: ביקר 'honor/riches' — BSB reads 'riches', KJV 'honour'; psalm context (49:6-18) favors wealth.

notes.subject: ⟨i⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin predicate marker required before verb, absent in Hebrew.

translation: Man long bikpela nem, tasol em i no save ⟨i⟩ tingting stret, em i wankain olsem ol animal bilong lukautim — ol i pinis.
